title: Use Microsoft Graph and non-Microsoft APIs in SharePoint Framework solutions
shortDescription: SharePoint Framework (SPFx) client-side web parts that call an anonymous REST API, a REST API secured with Microsoft Entra ID, and Microsoft Graph.
longDescription: SharePoint Framework (SPFx) client-side web parts that call an anonymous REST API, a REST API secured with Microsoft Entra ID, and Microsoft Graph.
This tutorial contains the completed code for the exercises in the Microsoft Learn module Use Microsoft Graph and non-Microsoft APIs in SharePoint Framework solutions.
